product_metadata.title: Linenspa Mattress Protector King - Five Sided King Mattress Protector Waterproof Mattress Cover – Soft Breathable Bed Protector - Fitted Sheet Style - Deep Pocket Up to 14”
features: NEXT LEVEL PROTECTION: Five sided waterproof mattress protector King size, guards the top and sides of your mattress against spills, stains, and accidents
SECURED FIT: Designed like a fitted sheet, this King size mattress protector keeps corners in place with its 14 inch deep pocket skirt and full-length elastic
NOISELESS COMFORT: Sleep comfortably with this breathable, smooth-brushed bed protector that's soft, quiet, and won’t change the feel of your mattress
VERSATILE USES: With multiple sizes available, every bed can stay protected. Waterproof mattress protector is great for kids, pets, or incontinence
EASY CARE: Easy-to-follow care instructions for washing and drying will help extend the life of your bed protector. Machine washable and dryer safe on low heat
description: Get next level mattress protection at a sensational value with the LINENSPA Five Sided Waterproof Mattress Protector. This fitted sheet style bed protector offers five-sided protection, meaning it guards the top and sides of your mattress from liquids, stains, and accidents. This mattress protector has a smooth surface made of soft brushed polyester that feels like microfiber. The breathable waterproof barrier is vinyl free and offers quiet protection without changing the feel of your mattress. The stretch skirt has a deep pocket design and a thick full length elastic to keep your protector in place. The waterproof mattress cover goes on easy and has a smooth, secure fit. Available in Twin, Twin XL, Full, Queen, King, and California King sizes, so you can make sure every room in your house stays protected. For convenience, the mattress protector can be machine washed and dried on low heat. Extend the life of your mattress and sleep comfortably with the LINENSPA Five Sided Waterproof Mattress Protector.
